patch_description:
This program is a crossover of the provided candidate ansatz designs. It preserves the fixed training, data handling, and measurement logic while proposing an improved ANSATZ_SPEC inside the EVOLVE-BLOCK.

Key ideas merged:
- Symmetry-sharing of single-qubit rotations (corner / edge / center) to reduce unique parameters and improve parameter efficiency (from prior designs).
- A shared RX "mixer" applied across all qubits (lightweight global mixing) to increase expressivity while keeping parameters low.
- A trainable CRZ lattice backbone for local entanglement on the outer ring and a separate shared CRZ for center-edge couplings (so center interactions can differ from the ring).
- Explicit ZZZ motifs aligned with the eight winning lines, split into row/column/diagonal groups to capture triple correlations using few parameters (motif-discovery inspiration).
- Doubly-controlled RZ (CCRZ) motifs focused on diagonals (corner-corner -> center) as a parameter-efficient way to emphasize diagonal correlations.
- Shared post-RZ symmetry groups to add phase flexibility without increasing parameter count.

Parameter budget is kept comparable to the successful prior runs (13 unique parameters per block => 78 total parameters over 6 blocks) to preserve efficient training while improving representational inductive biases aligned with tic-tac-toe structure. These changes aim to improve validation/test generalization and reduce overfitting by leveraging geometry-aware motifs and parameter sharing.
